grammarFocus: 倍数与比例表达；比较结构；过去和现在数据的时态选择。
title: Urban Transport Modes and Commuter Satisfaction in Three Cities
prompt: The chart below shows the average number of daily trips (in thousands) made by four transport modes in three cities—City A, City B, and City C—in 2023. The table below the chart shows the percentage of commuters in each city who rated their overall public transport system as 'satisfied' in the same year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作 Task 1 练习。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据图表和表格中的信息，概括主要特征并进行比较；不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议先识别图表中的关键对比点（如不同城市在各交通方式上的差异、满意度与使用量的关系），再组织段落。注意字数不少于150词。
